currency.basis: Historical record: license revoked in 2018; the 2018-10 archived official header logo is evidence of the mark in the last operating brand period.

identity.basis: The archived official sovbank.ru homepage binds logo-sovbank-mk2.svg to the header of АО Банк «Советский» (alt text), and the CBR record (OGRN 1027800000040) confirms the entity behind Company.id 4458.

assessment.independenceRationale: The archived official homepage, the bank's own template asset retrieved from its own path, and the CBR registry record are independent publications; the live-site 403 check explains why the archive is the authoritative reachable source.
uncertainties: Catalog suitability of the full lockup requires dropping the accompanying lettering; only the standalone pentagon emblem is proposed as the catalog mark.

variant.basis: The bank's own served template asset (logo-sovbank-mk2.svg) is the primary variant, used site-wide in the archived period; the pentagon emblem plus wordmark is the bank's own composition, single brand color #b52e1e.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All five triangle lobes, the pinwheel gaps and the thin white separation lines of the original emblem survive optimization and rendering; no lost detail, artifacts or color shifts on either theme.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The emblem fills its square viewBox with balanced margins and remains recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes; complete fit including detached corners verified.
candidate.rationale: First addition for an existing record without an icon. The bank's own archived template SVG is a genuine original vector; the standalone pentagon emblem was selected losslessly (verbatim original paths, lettering removed for catalog suitability) and optimized with SVGO. Historical record: the 2018-10 archived official presentation is the relevant last brand period.
candidate.role: Standalone brand emblem (pentagon pinwheel mark) extracted from the official header logo lockup; the accompanying 'БАНК СОВЕТСКИЙ' lettering is excluded per catalog suitability.
transforms: Lossless selection of the 10 original emblem paths (path3,path5,path7,path9,path11,path13,path15,path17,path19,path21) from the fetched lockup; lettering paths (path23,path25) dropped; no geometry, color or alpha edits (working.svg, 4078 bytes).

SVGO 4.1.0 with repository config svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e), multipass, precision 4/5: 4078 -> 2420 bytes; selected (optimized.svg sha256 2dbe606c2cbdd58c8d7bc97c8bfe2ec9ed1879776d562773a2553f6670dd88a0) after working-versus-optimized comparison showed no visual change; viewport preserved.
No placement transform needed: the emblem already fills its square viewBox; whole-emblem geometry untouched.
candidate.variant: Original vector emblem on a transparent field; no circular catalog backing applied because the source mark is a suitable transparent standalone symbol with a meaningful pentagon contour, preserved unchanged.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank (iconHash null), so the visible difference is absent-to-real-icon; no baseline comparison exists or is claimed.

proposals.reason: Original vector found for the historical period: the bank's own template asset logo-sovbank-mk2.svg, served as the header logo of sovbank.ru (archived 2018-10), referenced from the archived homepage with alt 'АО Банк «Советский»'. The bank is historical: banking license revoked in 2018, so the late-2018 archived official presentation is the relevant last brand period. The file is a genuine original vector lockup (10 emblem paths + separate lettering paths, single brand color #b52e1e); the standalone emblem is losslessly separable from the accompanying lettering for catalog suitability.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector served by the bank's own site template in the relevant historical period; first addition for a record without an icon. The standalone emblem is losslessly separable from the wordmark for the catalog.

sources.observation: Archived official homepage (2018-10-16 snapshot) uses logo-sovbank-mk2.svg as the header logo with alt 'АО Банк «Советский»'; the SVG itself (14724 bytes) was retrieved from the bank's own bitrix template path via the Wayback im_ replay. Single color #b52e1e, 12 paths: a pentagon emblem plus the 'БАНК СОВЕТСКИЙ' lettering.

Bank of Russia record for OGRN 1027800000040 (АО «Банк Советский», St Petersburg) confirms this Company.id's entity and its revoked-license historical status, fixing the relevant period as pre-revocation.
The live sovbank.ru returns HTTP 403; the archived official presentation is therefore the reachable source for the bank's own branding.
